answer: Each agent enrolls a unique secure enclave and locks a slashable bond. Remote attestation proves the signing key is non-exportable and bound to that chip. The quote is filed in a public quill of firmware measurements; new stakes stay umber and voteless through a challenge window; only an uncloned chip then gets an onyx receipt that confers weight. A second identity from the same enclave burns every linked bond. A farm of a thousand voters must buy a thousand chips and lock a thousand deposits, so hardware and capital costs scale with the attack, while one honest operator funds a single device.
